meta.title: Thermikdoku
meta.description: A kawaii logic puzzle with paragliders – one glider per row, column and thermal zone. No ads.
home.subtitle:
One glider per row, column and zone.
Don't collide!

toast.cleared: Fresh start. Tap “Undo” to bring it all back.
hint.wrongGlider: This glider is in the wrong spot. I'll take it away.
hint.wrongX: You put an × here, but this is exactly where a glider belongs.
hint.reveal: Tricky flight! A glider definitely flies here.
hint.single.row: Only one spot left in this row.
hint.single.col: Only one spot left in this column.
hint.single.zone: Only one spot left in this zone.
hint.zoneInLine.row: This zone lies entirely within one row. The rest of that row is blocked.
hint.zoneInLine.col: This zone lies entirely within one column. The rest of that column is blocked.
hint.lineInZone.row: This row only has spots left in one zone. The rest of that zone is blocked.
hint.lineInZone.col: This column only has spots left in one zone. The rest of that zone is blocked.
hint.block.row: A glider here would block the marked row completely.
hint.block.col: A glider here would block the marked column completely.
hint.block.zone: A glider here would block the marked zone completely.
hint.group: These {k} {from} only fit into {k} {to}. Everything else there is blocked.
hint.probe.row: Test flight: with a glider here, the marked row would run out of room later.
hint.probe.col: Test flight: with a glider here, the marked column would run out of room later.
hint.probe.zone: Test flight: with a glider here, the marked zone would run out of room later.
